question_text: Let's talk about your hometown. Where is it? What do you like most about it? Has it changed much since you were a child?
Do you work or are you a student? What do you do / what do you study? Why did you choose this job/subject? What do you enjoy most about it?
What do you like to do in your free time? How did you become interested in this hobby? Do you prefer to spend your free time alone or with others?
What kind of food do you like? Do you enjoy cooking? Has your taste in food changed since you were a child?
What's the weather like in your country? What is your favourite season, and why? Does the weather affect your mood?
How often do you use a smartphone? What do you mainly use it for? Do you think you spend too much time on your phone?
Do you like reading? What kind of books do you enjoy? Did you read a lot as a child?
What kind of music do you like? Do you play any musical instruments? Do you prefer listening to music alone or with friends?
Do you like travelling? What's the most interesting place you have visited? Would you prefer to travel alone or with a group?
How important are friends to you? What qualities do you look for in a friend? Do you prefer having a few close friends or many friends?
Do you enjoy shopping? Do you prefer shopping online or in physical stores? What was the last thing you bought?
Do you play any sports? Did you do sports when you were younger? Do you prefer watching sports or playing them?
Can you describe your typical daily routine? Has your routine changed much in the last few years? What part of your day do you enjoy most?
Do you know your neighbours well? Do you think it's important to have a good relationship with neighbours? Has this changed compared to the past?
How do you usually travel around your city? Do you prefer public transport or private vehicles? Is public transport good in your city?
Are you interested in art? Did you study art at school? Do you ever visit art galleries or museums?
Do you like taking photos? What do you usually take photos of? Do you prefer looking at old photos or taking new ones?
